question: Who is the captain of the Indian women's cricket team for the commonwealth game 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harmanpreet Kaur__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana were named captain and vice-captain of the Indian team ahead of the 2022 CWG in Birmingham.
 
• **India's women's cricket team won a silver medal **they lost a match against Australia by nine runs.
